newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Eng in $500 mln Thai petrochem plant deal.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Eng in $500 mln Thai petrochem plant deal.

text.p: Samsung Engineering Co, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Monday it had won a $500 million contract from Thai Petrochemical Industry Public Co Ltd to build an ethylene plant in Thailand on a turn-key basis.
Samsung said in a statement it had won the deal jointly with its sister firm, Samsung Corp.
Samsung Engineering will build the plant, with an annual capacity for 700,000 tonnes of ethylene, by July 1999 with technical assistance from Germany's Linde AG, the statement said.
The Export and Import Bank of Korea will help finance part of the deal, it said.
